body.description: Request body to generate an NSQL query

datasets.description: Names of datasets to sample from when constructing model context; this is a sampling hint and does not restrict which tables queries can target. If omitted, all datasets are used.

model.description: The name of the model to use for SQL generation. If omitted, Spice defaults to the only compatible LLM model configured in the Spicepod.

prompt_cache_key.description: Stable prompt-cache key forwarded to the configured NSQL model for provider-specific cache handling.

query.description: The natural language query to be converted into SQL

oneOf.description: How much the model reasons before it writes SQL. Omitted keeps the model setting.
oneOf.title: ReasoningEffort

sample_data_enabled.description: Whether sample data is included in the context for SQL generation. Default: false

stream.description: If true, streams the response instead of waiting for completion

example.query: Get the top 5 customers by total sales
